context:
Goal: CI-speed and mutation-report PRs merge in the five child repos tonight (q_max, banchi, mailaudit, ios-adblock, joyous), as you picked on item 820.
Problem (rule): `merge --lane-lint` reads UNKNOWN on every child head, because no child repo's checks.yml has a `touched` job (the coordinator's REST read of checks.yml at 00:33 CST in q_max, degen, home, banchi, ios-adblock and joyous; mailaudit read later, same result). The tool refuses to hand the head to a batch runner unless `--lint-unknown-ok "<reason>"` is given; that flag lifts a check, and the coordinator's rule and runner 12's brief give none. Refusal text for q_max #1171 at 69756b1e1, unchanged: "the draft run of lane-touched-tests on 69756b1e1 is unknown, not a pass: no `touched` job (lane-touched-tests) has run ... Do not hand this head to the batch runner or join it to a batch until the lint passes. (decision lanes-run-no-full-ci-job)".
Based on (read): decision lanes-run-no-full-ci-job line 14 ("An unknown refuses unless --lint-unknown-ok <reason> is given, and the reason is logged"), quoted by the coordinator; the refusal text from batch runner 12, 00:33 CST, relayed; step child-lane-lint-no-touched-job (triage's read: neither line says who may type the flag; past practice put it to you as a page act, items act-3126-lint-unknown-ok and act-lint-unknown-ok-3259); your ruling own-775-b-wait (19:42 CST Nov 13: the unknown on #3259 stays unlifted). Also read (batch runner 12, relaying runner 11, 00:35 CST, from runner 11's transcript; unchecked by triage): home #702 and #704 merged on the old batch route `--batch-build NAME --ready --lint-unknown-ok <reason>`, reason "no lane-touched-tests draft run exists on <sha>; touched tests run locally by --touched-tests". No plain lint pass in any child repo; in degen no head has passed it (#702 was merged by you). On stable the form is `merge <pr> --confirm --lint-unknown-ok REASON`, never run. mailaudit's checks.yml (main bbdf2268) also has no touched job. So the per-PR flag with a logged reason is the existing route in home; whether you approved it per PR is not read. Batch runner 12's reading: only a lane adding the touched job to each child repo fits your rule (a repo changes to fit a shared tool), and it reads option a as lifting a check. The recommendation of a is the coordinator's, not triage's and not runner 12's.
Departs from: main — a child head needs a lint that reads pass, or an unknown that refuses; a lets child heads with no touched job reach a batch with the reason logged each time, in the five repos; b gives each child repo a touched job so the lint reads for real; c makes the merge tool treat a repo with no touched job as not applicable.
Meanwhile: runner 12 builds no batch in q_max; the lanes in the other four repos build but hand in nothing past the lint; claude-settings work goes on.
home: step child-lane-lint-no-touched-job; decision lanes-run-no-full-ci-job; ruling own-775-b-wait; batch runner 12
lastAnswer: 822: withdrawn by the coordinator, 00:36 CST Nov 14; your 21:01 CST Nov 13 answer a already covers it.

options.label: Grant --lint-unknown-ok "child repo has no touched job" per PR in the five repos, reason logged each time (recommended by the coordinator, with b as a step)
options.lose: The lane lint check is lifted in the five child repos until b lands, on a standing grant instead of a page act per PR.

options.gain: The lint reads for real in every child repo.
options.label: A lane adds a touched job to each child repo's checks.yml first
options.lose: Seven repos change, one more job per run, and the child lanes wait for it.

options.how: Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo
options.label: Make the merge tool treat a repo with no touched job as not applicable
options.lose: The tool changes to fit the repos, and the lint is off wherever a repo has no job.

reply: WITHDRAWN. Your ruling own-lint-skip-green-rollup-a (21:01 CST Nov 13, answer a on item 799: skip the lane lint at the merge when the head's all-jobs-passed rollup is green) already settles this for any child head with a green rollup: the runner passes --lint-unknown-ok with that ruling as the reason. A head without a green rollup still waits. Nothing for you to decide. The long-run fix (a touched job in each child repo) stays as step child-lane-lint-no-touched-job, not a question tonight. This item should not have been posted: triage's past-ruling check searched the flag's words and missed the ruling. Guard: step past-ruling-before-post.
short: Child repos' lane lint reads unknown: grant the flag, add a job, or skip the check?
title: Lane lint reads UNKNOWN on every child repo head (no touched job), so no child PR reaches a batch. Grant --lint-unknown-ok "child repo has no touched job" per PR in the five repos (a), add a touched job to each child repo (b), or make the merge tool skip the lint where no such job exists (c)?
why: The merge tool refuses to hand a head to a batch runner while lane lint is unknown, unless --lint-unknown-ok is typed. That flag lifts a check, and past practice put each use to you as a page act. Only you lift a check.
